sources.title: Abuja Area Mama, Nigerian transgender TikToker, found dead
sources.claim_summary: BBC News (9 Aug 2024): the killing of 'Abuja Area Mama', a 33-year-old transgender TikToker with ~10,000 followers, found beaten beside a capital-city highway hours after announcing she was going out; she had been stabbed in Sept 2023 and had expressed fear for her life; police opened a 'thorough and discreet' investigation. The report notes mass arrests and detention of LGBTQ+ Nigerians are common, especially in northern states.

sources.title: Threats, Raids and Potlucks — The Dial
sources.claim_summary: The Dial, Issue 25: 'Threats, Raids and Potlucks' - reporting on the queer scene in the federal capital: threats and police raids alongside informal community organising, and community grief after the murder of 'Abuja Area Mama' (Aug 2024).

SaharaReporters (19 Aug 2026): the UK FCDO's updated travel advice warns LGBT+ travellers to Nigeria of arrest, violence, attacks, blackmail and intimidation - same-sex conduct carries up to 14 years, some northern states apply Sharia provisions that can prescribe the death penalty, and the same-sex marriage law reaches those who help arrange or attend such weddings.
